thabo.situation: Imali yokugibela ekheshi izinsuku eziningi kanye nenkokhelo ye-app ngoMsombuluko. Uphethiloli nenkokhelo yemoto kuza kuqala.

lerato.situation: Imigqibelo ithwala iviki. Ukuthenga imikhiqizo kabusha njalo emavikini amabili nerenti ngomhla wokuqala.

ayanda.situation: Imali yekheshi ingena ngezinqwaba. Ukuthenga isitoko okukhulu nogesi okhokhelwa kuqala phakathi.

consent.lead: Nakhu okusetshenziswa yi-Tengo, ukuthi kungani, nokuthi yini ongakushintsha.

what.title: Esikusebenzisayo
what.body: Izinsuku zokuthengiselana, izimali nezincazelo, kanye nebhalansi yakho yamanje. Akukho okunye.

why.title: Kungani
why.body: Ukubala ukuthi imali yakho ihlala isikhathi esingakanani nokuthi imali yakho elandelayo kungenzeka ingene nini. Hhayi ngokukhangisa noma ukulinganisa isikweletu.

who.title: Ubani ongakubona
who.body: Noma ubani osebenzisa lesi siphequluli kule divayisi. Akekho e-Tengo ongakubona.

where.title: Lapho kucutshungulwa khona
where.body: Esiphequlini sakho, kule divayisi. Akukho okuthunyelwa kuseva.

how.title: Sikugcina isikhathi esingakanani
how.body: Amarekhodi angaphezu kwezinyanga eziyi-12 ayasuswa kule divayisi. Ungasusa konke noma nini.

core.title: Isibikezelo
core.body: Kuyadingeka ukuze usebenzise i-Tengo. Hoxisa noma nini bese isibikezelo siyamiswa.

messages.title: Imilayezo yansuku zonke
messages.body: Isibuyekezo esifushane sansuku zonke esinosuku lwakho, nge-WhatsApp noma nge-SMS. Imilayezo ye-WhatsApp idlula ku-Meta, ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika. Ivaliwe uze uyivule. Kuyalingiswa, akukho okuthunyelwayo.

analytics.title: Ukuhlaziywa komkhiqizo
analytics.body: Kusiza ukuthuthukisa i-Tengo. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Akukho kuhlaziya okwenzeka kule demo.

securityItems.shared: Noma ubani osebenzisa lesi siphequluli kule divayisi angayivula. Yisuse noma nini.

securityItems.accountRls: Umugqa ngamunye ukhiyelwe kuwe esizindalwazini, ngakho ayikho enye i-akhawunti engawufunda, iwushintshe noma iwususe.

why.title: Kungani lolu suku
why.plain: Siqala ngebhalansi yakho yanamuhla, sisuse izinkokhelo ngezinsuku zazo, bese sisebenzisa ngezinga lakho elijwayelekile lansuku zonke kuze kube yilapho imali ifika kuziro. Lolo suku wusuku lwakho. Imali ongakayitholi ayibalwa.
why.chartLabel: Indlela ibhalansi encipha ngayo ngeviki elijwayelekile, elilula nelinzima
why.dailySpendHint: Iviki elilula kuya kwelinzima: {{low}} kuya ku-{{high}} ngosuku

rule.enough: Ngisho neviki elinzima lihlala kuze kufike imali elandelayo engenzeka sekwephuze kakhulu.
rule.tight: Iviki elijwayelekile lihlala kuze kufike imali elandelayo ejwayelekile. Iviki elinzima alihlali.
rule.short: Iviki elijwayelekile liyaphela ngaphambi kwemali elandelayo ejwayelekile.
rule.unclear: Umlando awanele noma ayikho imali engenayo, ngakho alukabikho usuku.

paused.title: Isibikezelo simisiwe
paused.body: Uhoxise imvume yesibikezelo, ngakho i-Tengo ayisebenzisi imininingwane yakho. Qhubeka futhi ukuze ubone usuku lwakho, noma ususe imininingwane yakho.

me.title: Mina
me.nameBody: I-Tengo isuka egameni elithi mutengo, igama lesiTshivenda elisho ukubaluleka. Le ncazelo inikezwe ngumsunguli futhi isazoqinisekiswa ngumuntu okhuluma isiTshivenda.

how.1: Ihlukanisa umlando wakho ube imali engenayo, izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile nokusebenzisa kwansuku zonke.
how.2: Ibala ukusebenzisa kwakho okujwayelekile kwansuku zonke ezinsukwini ezingu-60 zokugcina, kanye neviki elilula neviki elinzima.
how.3: Ithola ukuthi imali yakho elandelayo ivame ukungena nini nokuthi ivame ukuba malini.
how.4: Yehlisa ibhalansi yakho usuku nosuku, isuse izinkokhelo ngezinsuku zazo, ize ifike kuziro. Lolo suku wusuku lwakho.
how.5: Iqhathanisa lolo suku nemali yakho elandelayo ukuze ibeke isimo sakho: Yanele, Iqinile noma Iyashoda.

sim.bank: Akukho ukuxhumana nebhange futhi akukho i-open banking.
sim.messages: Imilayezo iyizibonelo zokubuka kuqala. Akukho okuthunyelwayo.
sim.privacy: Izilawuli zobumfihlo zikhombisa umkhuba omuhle. Akusona isitifiketi sokuthobela umthetho.
sim.translations: IsiNgisi siwumthombo. Ezinye izilimi eziyi-10 ziyizinhlaka ze-AI abantu abakhuluma lezo zilimi njengezilimi zebele okusafanele bazihlole, ngakho amanye amagama angase angalungi.

me.resetBody: Isusa abantu abaqanjiwe, iphrofayela yakho kule divayisi, ukukhetha kwemvume namarekhodi, bese iqala kabusha. I-akhawunti, uma ugcine eyodwa, ayithintwa.

me.themeHint: Emnyama iyinto ezenzakalelayo. Isistimu ilandela idivayisi yakho.

money.importBody: Layisha isitatimende sasebhange se-CSV. Sifundwa kule divayisi futhi sithatha indawo yomlando walo muntu.
money.movableHint: Maka inkokhelo kuphela uma ingakhokhwa sekwephuze izinsuku ezimbalwa ngaphandle kwemali yenhlawulo.
money.protectedBill: Akusoze kwaphakanyiswa ukuthi ihanjiswe: ukukhokha sekwephuzile kungabiza izimali, ukuvikelwa noma isikweletu.

import.title: Ngenisa isitatimende
import.lead: Sebenzisa isitatimende sasebhange se-CSV ukuze uthathe indawo yomlando walo muntu. Asisoze saphuma esiphequlini sakho.
import.local: Kucutshungulwa kudivayisi yakho. Akukho okuphuma esiphequlini sakho.
import.formatBody: Usuku, incazelo nenani (elingaphansi kweziro emalini ephumayo), noma amakholomu ahlukene e-debit ne-credit. Okungenani izinsuku eziyi-14.
import.empty: Khetha ifayela noma usebenzise isitatimende esiyisibonelo ukuze ubone ukubuka kuqala lapha.
import.mappingHint: Siqagele lokhu ezihlokweni. Shintsha noma yikuphi okubukeka kungalungile.
import.needMapping: Khetha usuku, incazelo, kanye nenani noma amakholomu e-debit ne-credit.
import.skipped_one: Kweqiwe umugqa o-{{count}} ngoba usuku, incazelo noma inani akukwazanga ukufundwa.
import.skipped_other: Kweqiwe imigqa engu-{{count}} ngoba usuku, incazelo noma inani akukwazanga ukufundwa.
import.tooShort: Lesi sitatimende sihlanganisa izinsuku ezingu-{{count}}. I-Tengo idinga okungenani eziyi-14.
import.noRows: Ayikho imigqa esebenzisekayo etholakele ngala makholomu.
import.wideRange: Izinsuku ezingu-{{count}} kuphela zomlando. Isibikezelo sizosebenza, kodwa ibanga lizoba libanzi.
import.shifted_one: Izinsuku zihanjiswe phambili ngosuku olu-{{count}} ukuze isitatimende siphele izolo.
import.shifted_other: Izinsuku zihanjiswe phambili ngezinsuku ezingu-{{count}} ukuze isitatimende siphele izolo.
import.balanceFromFile: Ithathwe ebhalansini yokugcina efayeleni: {{amount}}. Thayipha ukuze uyishintshe.
import.balanceKept: Ayikho ikholomu yebhalansi. Kugcinwa ibhalansi yamanje ka-{{amount}}. Thayipha ukuze uyishintshe.
import.confirm: Faka umlando omusha bese ubona usuku lwami
import.replaceNote: Lokhu kuthatha indawo yomlando walo muntu kule divayisi futhi kufaka okufakiwe erekhodini lokuhlola.
import.tooBig: Lelo fayela likhulu kuno-2 MB, okungaphezu kwalokho isitatimende esikudingayo. Khetha isikhathi esifushane noma ifayela elincane.

edit.title: Hlela ukuthengiselana
edit.auditNote: Ukugcina kufaka okufakiwe erekhodini lakho lokuhlola.
edit.oneOffHint: Kushiywe ngaphandle kwephethini yakho ejwayelekile yokusebenzisa nemali engenayo. Kusabalwa ebhalansini yakho.

audit.bill_answered: Kuphendulwe umbuzo mayelana nenkokhelo ebibukeka ingakhokhelwanga
audit.plan_settings: Kushintshwe ukusebenzisa okungancishiswa noma izinkokhelo ezingahanjiswa

inbox.title: Imilayezo
inbox.offBody: Uvale imilayezo yansuku zonke, ngakho akukho okungabukwa kuqala. Yivule lapha noma ku-Ubumfihlo.

facts.what: Usuku lwakho, isimo nesabelomali sansuku kuphela.
facts.never: Akusoze kwaba yibhalansi yakho noma ukuthengiselana kwakho.
facts.stop: Umlayezo ngamunye usho ukuthi uvela ku-Tengo nokuthi ungayimisa kanjani. Ungavala imilayezo futhi ku-Ubumfihlo.
facts.where: Imilayezo ye-WhatsApp ibingadlula ku-Meta, ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika. I-SMS iyenye indlela. Kuyalingiswa lapha: akukho okuthunyelwayo.

whatsapp.enough: Imali yakho kufanele ihlale kuze kube ngu-*{{date}}*. Isimo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.tight: Imali yakho kufanele ihlale kuze kube ngu-*{{date}}* ngeviki elijwayelekile. Isimo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.short_one: Imali yakho ingase iphele ngo-*{{date}}*, usuku olu-{{count}} ngaphambi kwemali yakho elandelayo. Isimo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.short_other: Imali yakho ingase iphele ngo-*{{date}}*, izinsuku ezingu-{{count}} ngaphambi kwemali yakho elandelayo. Isimo: {{state}}.

tip.enough: Uvikelekile kuze kufike imali yakho elandelayo, ngisho nangeviki elinzima.
tip.tight: Gcina ukusebenzisa kwakho eduze nesabelomali sakho sansuku kuze kufike imali yakho elandelayo.
tip.short: Bheka u-Hlela ku-Tengo ukuze ubone okusiza kakhulu.

whatsapp.stsNotAdvised: Isabelomali sansuku: akunconywa kuze kufike imali yakho elandelayo.
whatsapp.unclear: I-Tengo ayikabi nokwanele ukukunika usuku. Vula i-Tengo ukuze ubone ukuthi yini okufanele uyifake.
whatsapp.stsPending: Isabelomali sansuku: sizobalwa uma inkokhelo yanamuhla isingenile.
whatsapp.stop: Kuvela ku-Tengo. Phendula ngo-STOP ukuze umise lezi zibuyekezo.
whatsapp.discreet: Tengo: isibuyekezo sakho sansuku zonke silungile. Vula i-app ukuze usibone.
whatsapp.noNextDaily: Imali ingena izinsuku eziningi, ngakho ayikho inkokhelo eyodwa elandelayo.

sms.tight: Tengo: Sawubona {{name}}, imali ihlala kuze kube ngu-{{date}} ngeviki elijwayelekile ({{state}}). Isabelomali {{sts}} ngosuku.
sms.short: Tengo: Sawubona {{name}}, imali ingase iphele ngo-{{date}} ({{state}}). Isabelomali asinconywa.

help.title: Okusiza kakhulu
help.moveBill: Uma i-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ingakhokhwa ngemuva kuka-{{date}} ngaphandle kwemali yenhlawulo, lokho kuphela kufinyelela ku-{{state}}.
help.setAside: Ungabeka eceleni kuze kufike ku-{{amount}} namuhla futhi usahlala ku-Yanele kuze kufike imali yakho elandelayo. Lesi yisikhala esifanayo nesithi Isikhala sokuboleka, hhayi esengeziwe.
help.coveredBody: Imali yakho kufanele ihlale kuze kufike imali yakho elandelayo, ngisho nangeviki elinzima kakhulu.
help.earn: Thola noma wamukele u-{{amount}} owengeziwe ngaphambi kuka-{{date}}, isibonelo umsebenzi owengeziwe noma imali okweletwa yona.
help.earnAssume: Kucatshangwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa kwakho kuhlala njengokujwayelekile. Ukuboleka ukuze uvale igebe kuvame ukubiza kakhulu kamuva.
help.trim: Sebenzisa cishe u-{{amount}} ngosuku ngaphansi ku-{{groups}} kuze kube ngu-{{date}}.
help.trimAssume: Ukusebenzisa kuphela okumake njengokungancishiswa. Kucatshangwa ukuthi konke okunye kuhlala njengokujwayelekile.
help.trimPartial: Lokho kungukusebenzisa konke okumake njengokungancishiswa, ngakho kuvala ingxenye yegebe. Okusele kusadinga imali engenayo.
help.moveAssume: Uyimake njengengahanjiswa. Buza kuqala. Ungalokothi weqe ama-debit order ezikweletu noma omshwalense.
help.markFlexible: Maka ukusebenzisa kwansuku zonke okungancishiswa ukuze ubone lapho ungasika khona.
help.freeHelp: Uma usalele ngemuva ezikweletini, i-National Credit Regulator ibala usizo lwamahhala:
help.ideasNote: Imibono, akusona iseluleko. Hlola izimali nezinhlawulo ngaphambi kokushintsha inkokhelo.

spending.title: Lapho imali yansuku zonke iya khona
spending.empty: Akukho ukusebenzisa kwansuku zonke ezinsukwini ezingu-30 zokugcina.
spending.flexibleHint: Maka ukusebenzisa ongakunciphisa uma imali ishoda. Izindleko zomsebenzi ezifana nesitoko nophethiloli azisoze zaphakanyiswa ukuthi zinqunywe.

palette.title: Imenyu yemiyalo
palette.placeholder: Iya ekhasini, shintsha umuntu, shintsha ulimi
palette.help: Izinkinobho zemicibisholo ukuze uhambe, u-Enter ukuze ukhethe, u-Esc ukuze uvale.

overdrawn.title: Ukweleta ngo-{{amount}} ebhange
overdrawn.body: Imali engenayo ikhokha lokhu kuqala. Usuku lwakho lubalwa kusukela lapho ibhalansi isingaphezu kuka-R0 futhi.

asOf.title: Kusuka esitatimendeni sakho
asOf.body_one: Lesi sibikezelo sivela esitatimendeni sakho, esiphela ngo-{{date}}, osukwini olu-{{count}} olwedlule. Faka ibhalansi yanamuhla ukuze usibuyekeze.
asOf.body_other: Lesi sibikezelo sivela esitatimendeni sakho, esiphela ngo-{{date}}, ezinsukwini ezingu-{{count}} ezedlule. Faka ibhalansi yanamuhla ukuze usibuyekeze.

historyEnds.title: Umlando uphela ngo-{{date}}
historyEnds.body: Ukusebenzisa kusukela ngaleso sikhathi akukho emlandweni wakho, ngakho isibikezelo sisebenzisa iphethini kuze kube yilolo suku nebhalansi yanamuhla.

paused.title: Imali engenayo ibukeka imisiwe
paused.body: Akukho okufana nezinkokhelo zakho ezijwayelekile okungenile kusukela ngo-{{date}}. I-Tengo ayisathembeli emalini elandelayo futhi esikhundleni salokho ihlola izinsuku ezingu-30 ezizayo.

notice.pausedNoDate: Akukho okufana nezinkokhelo zakho ezijwayelekile okungenile isikhathi esithile. I-Tengo ayisathembeli emalini elandelayo futhi esikhundleni salokho ihlola izinsuku ezingu-30 ezizayo.

irregular.title: Ayikabi khona iphethini ejwayelekile
irregular.body: Imali iyangena, kodwa hhayi ngesigqi i-Tengo engasisebenzisa. Ihlola izinsuku ezingu-30 ezizayo esikhundleni sosuku lwemali elandelayo.

pendingToday.title: Inkokhelo ifanele namuhla
pendingToday.body: Inkokhelo yakho ejwayelekile ifanele namuhla futhi ayikangeni ebhalansini yakho, ngakho isabalwa njengezayo.

missedBill.title: I-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ibukeka ingakhokhiwe
missedBill.body: Ibifanele cishe ngo-{{date}} futhi ayibonakalanga. Tshela i-Tengo ukuthi kwenzekeni ukuze usuku luhlale lulungile.

oneOffs.body_one: Imali enkulu eyenzeka kanye engu-{{count}} ishiywe ngaphandle kokusebenzisa nemali engenayo ejwayelekile.
oneOffs.body_other: Izimali ezinkulu ezenzeka kanye ezingu-{{count}} zishiywe ngaphandle kokusebenzisa nemali engenayo ejwayelekile.

notice.label: Izinto okufanele uzihlole

askOneOff.title: Ingabe i-{{name}} ({{amount}}, {{date}}) ibiyinto eyenzeka kanye?
askOneOff.body: Inkulu kakhulu kunokusebenzisa kwakho okujwayelekile, futhi ngomlando omfushane i-Tengo ayikwazi ukusho. Okwamanje ibalwa njengokusebenzisa okujwayelekile.

estimated.title: Kulinganiselwe ezimpendulweni zakho
estimated.body: Ingxenye yomlando wakho ivela emibuzweni yokusetha, ngakho ukuqiniseka kuphansi. Okufakiwe kwangempela, ukheshi owufaka lapha noma isitatimende kuthatha indawo yesilinganiso.

sample.title: Izinombolo eziyisibonelo
sample.body: Lesi sibikezelo sisebenzisa izinombolo eziyisibonelo, hhayi ezakho. Zishintshe ku-Imali, noma uzithathele indawo ngesitatimende noma ngezimpendulo zakho.

quota.title: Ayikwazanga ukugcina kule divayisi
quota.body: Isitoreji salesi siphequluli sigcwele, ngakho ushintsho lwakho lokugcina alugcinwanga. Khipha imininingwane yakho, bese ukhulula isikhala noma ususe imininingwane endala.

unavailable.title: Ayikwazanga ukugcina kule divayisi
unavailable.body: Lesi siphequluli sivimba isitoreji, isibonelo efasiteleni eliyimfihlo, ngakho ushintsho lwakho lokugcina alugcinwanga.

corrupt.title: Imininingwane yakho egciniwe ayikwazanga ukufundwa
corrupt.body: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle ngemininingwane egcinwe kulesi siphequluli. Ikhophi igcinwe kule divayisi. Qala kabusha ukuze uqhubeke usebenzisa i-Tengo.

hints.in: Ukheshi owutholile, isibonelo imali yokugibela, iklayenti noma imali ebuyiswe ngumndeni. Ibalwa njengemali engenayo.
hints.hand: Ukheshi onawo manje. Lokhu kusetha ibhalansi kakheshi futhi akufaki okufakiwe.

accounts.title: Lapho imali yakho ikhona
accounts.lead: Isibikezelo sakho sisebenzisa isamba sakho konke lokhu.
accounts.name: Igama

obligations.title: Enye imali oyikweletayo
obligations.lead: Istokvel, umasingcwabisane, ukusekela umndeni nezikweletu ezingekho emthethweni. Kubalwa njengezinkokhelo.
obligations.name: Igama
obligations.movableHint: Kuphela uma ingakhokhwa sekwephuze izinsuku ezimbalwa ngaphandle kwenkinga.
obligations.protected: Akusoze kwaphakanyiswa ukuthi kuhanjiswe: ukukhokha isikweletu noma umasingcwabisane sekwephuzile kungakubiza.

setup.title: Setha ngesandla
setup.lead: Awunaso isitatimende? Phendula imibuzo embalwa bese i-Tengo ilinganisela umlando wokuqala. Okufakiwe kwangempela kuthatha indawo yawo njengoba ukufaka.
setup.pretend: Ungasebenzisa izinombolo zokuzenzisa ukuze ukuzame. Akukho okuphuma kule divayisi.
setup.arrives: Indlela imali yakho evame ukungena ngayo

arrivalHint.daily: Isibonelo imali yokugibela ekheshi noma ukuthengisa izinsuku eziningi.
arrivalHint.weekly: Isibonelo inkokhelo yamaviki onke noma imali yangoMgqibelo.
arrivalHint.monthly: Isibonelo inkokhelo yanyanga zonke noma isibonelelo.
arrivalHint.irregular: Isibonelo imali efakwayo cishe njalo ngeviki, kodwa hhayi ngosuku olunqunyiwe.

setup.dailySpendHint: Ukudla, ukuthutha, i-airtime nokunye okunjalo. Hhayi irenti noma ezinye izinkokhelo.
setup.billsHint: Irenti, inkontileka yocingo, imali yesikole nezinye izinkokhelo ezikhokhwa njalo ngenyanga.
setup.billError: Inkokhelo ngayinye idinga igama, inani elingaphezu kweziro nosuku olusuka ku-1 kuya ku-31.
setup.estimatedNote: I-Tengo yenza umlando wokuqala kusuka kulezi zimpendulo, umakwe njengolinganiselwe. Ukuqiniseka kuhlala kuphansi kuze kufike okufakiwe kwangempela.

safetyPolicy.title: Ukuphepha nokuthi i-Tengo ingeyabani
safetyPolicy.lead: Indlela i-Tengo evikela ngayo abantu abasebenzisa amafoni abiwe, abantu abasengozini nezingane.
safetyPolicy.draft: Inqubomgomo eyuhlaka yocwaningo lokulinga, ezobuyekezwa ngummeli nomeluleki wokuvikela.

adults.title: Abantu abadala kuphela
adults.body: I-Tengo ingeyabantu abadala. Uma uneminyaka engaphansi kuka-18, sicela ungayisebenzisi. Ukugcina ku-akhawunti kukucela ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uneminyaka eyi-18 noma ngaphezulu. I-Tengo ayiceli usuku lokuzalwa noma inombolo kamazisi, futhi abantu abaqanjiwe bedemo bangabantu abadala.

shared.title: Amafoni abiwe
shared.body: Ungasetha i-PIN ukuze i-Tengo izikhiye ngemuva kwemizuzu embalwa, uvule imodi yokufihla ukuze izimali zihlale zifihliwe uze uthinte ukuze uzibone, futhi usebenzise ukuphuma ngokushesha ukuze ushiye i-Tengo uye ekhasini elingenalutho ngaso leso sikhathi. Imilayezo efihliwe ayinazo izimali, izinsuku noma amagama esimo.

control.title: Uma umuntu ephethe imali yakho
control.body: Akekho okufanele akuphoqe ukuthi ukhombise isibikezelo sakho, wabelane nge-PIN yakho noma unikele ngemali yakho. I-Tengo ayisoze yacela igama eliyimfihlo lasebhange noma i-PIN. Uma umuntu ehlola ifoni yakho, ukuphuma ngokushesha nokukhiya nge-PIN kuyasiza, futhi ungasusa imininingwane yakho noma nini ku-Ubumfihlo.

care.title: Ukunakekela abantu abasesimweni esinzima
care.body: I-Tengo isebenzisa amagama alula, ikhombisa izilinganiso hhayi iseluleko, futhi ayisoze yaphakamisa ukuboleka, ukweqa inkokhelo yesikweletu noma yomshwalense, noma ukusika isitoko sebhizinisi. Uma imali ibukeka ishoda, ikhomba usizo lwamahhala oluvela ku-National Credit Regulator.

never.title: Lokho i-Tengo engasoze yakwenza
never.body: I-Tengo ayenzi izinqumo zokuboleka noma zesikweletu, ayithengisi imikhiqizo, futhi ayabelani ngemininingwane yakho nanoma ubani ngokukhangisa. Akukho mayelana nesibikezelo sakho okusetshenziselwa ukukwahlulela.

help.title: Uma udinga usizo manje
help.gbv: I-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, mahhala futhi ivulekile imini nobusuku.
help.childline: I-Childline, yezingane nanoma ubani okhathazekile ngengane: 116, mahhala.
help.note: Izinombolo zizoqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokwethulwa. I-Tengo akuyona insizakalo yezimo eziphuthumayo.

lock.title: I-Tengo ikhiyiwe
lock.lead: Faka i-PIN yakho ukuze uvule i-Tengo.
lock.wait: Imizamo miningi kakhulu. Linda isikhashana bese uzama futhi.
lock.waitFor_one: Imizamo miningi kakhulu. Zama futhi ngemuva komzuzwana o-{{count}}.
lock.waitFor_other: Imizamo miningi kakhulu. Zama futhi ngemuva kwemizuzwana engu-{{count}}.
lock.forgotBody: I-Tengo ayikwazi ukubuyisa i-PIN, ngoba ayisoze yagcinwa. Ukuze uqale kabusha, susa yonke imininingwane ye-Tengo kule divayisi. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.

shared.title: Ukuphepha kwefoni eyabiwe
shared.lockOff: Kuvaliwe. Setha i-PIN yezinombolo ezi-4 kuya kwezi-6 ukuze ukhiye i-Tengo uma ungekho.
shared.lockOn: Kuvuliwe. I-Tengo iyazikhiya ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-{{count}} ingasetshenziswa.
shared.pinHint: Izinombolo ezi-4 kuya kwezi-6. Igcinwa kuphela njengekhodi exubile kule divayisi futhi ayikwazi ukubuyiswa.
shared.discreetHint: Fihla izimali esikrinini uze uthinte u-Khombisa izimali, futhi uthumele imilayezo engenazo izimali noma izinsuku.
shared.quickExitHint: Ukuphuma ngokushesha kuhlala kuphezulu esikrinini. Kufihla konke futhi kuvule ikhasi elingenalutho.

diag.title: Ukuhlola amaphutha
diag.lead: Okosizo ngenkinga. Ayikho imininingwane yomuntu siqu egcinwa lapha, futhi akukho okuthunyelwayo.

own.cardPromise: Izinombolo zakho, usuku lwakho. Akukho okuphuma kudivayisi yakho ngaphandle uma ugcina i-akhawunti.
own.cardBody: Ngenisa isitatimende, phendula imibuzo embalwa, noma uzame kuqala ngezinombolo eziyisibonelo. Akudingeki ukubhalisa.

welcome.title: Sebenzisa imali yakho
welcome.nicknameHint: Lisetshenziselwa ukukubingelela kuphela. Lishiye lingenalutho uma uthanda.

s1.title: Lokho i-Tengo ekucelayo, nokuthi kungani
s1.lead: I-Tengo ibala ukuthi imali yakho ihlala isikhathi esingakanani nokuthi imali yakho elandelayo ivame ukungena nini. Idinga okuncane kuphela ukuze ikwenze lokho.

money.title: Imali yakho engenayo nephumayo
money.body: Izinsuku, izimali nezincazelo ezimfushane, kanye nebhalansi yakho. Kusuka esitatimendeni, ezimpendulweni ezimbalwa, noma ezinombolweni eziyisibonelo.

bills.title: Izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile nemali oyikweletayo
bills.body: Izinto ezifana nerenti, inkontileka yocingo noma istokvel, ukuze i-Tengo ikwazi ukugcina imali yazo.

never.title: Akusoze
never.body: I-Tengo ayisoze yacela inombolo kamazisi, inombolo yocingo, ukungena ebhange noma i-PIN.

where.title: Lapho kuhlala khona
where.body: Kule divayisi kuphela, ngaphandle uma kamuva ukhetha ukukugcina ku-akhawunti. Ungakususa noma nini.

s2.title: Ukukhetha kwakho
s2.lead: Isibikezelo kuphela esidingekayo. Konke okunye kuvaliwe uze ukuvule.
s2.core: Kuyadingeka ukuze kubalwe usuku lwakho. Kusebenza kule divayisi. Hoxisa noma nini bese kuyama.
s2.notice: Isaziso esigcwele sobumfihlo sisho okugcinwayo, lapho, isikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi ungakhalaza kanjani.

s3.title: Faka imali yakho
s3.lead: Khetha indlela eyodwa. Ungayishintsha noma uyithathele indawo kamuva ku-Imali.
s3.importBody: Ifayela le-CSV elivela ebhange lakho. Lifundwa kule divayisi.
s3.manualBody: Uma ungenaso isitatimende. I-Tengo ilinganisela umlando wokuqala kusuka ezimpendulweni zakho.
s3.sampleBody: Hlola ngaphandle kokuthayipha lutho. Isibonelo simakiwe futhi ungashintsha yonke inombolo.

s4.lead: Lesi yisilinganiso esivela ezinombolweni ozinikezile, akusona iseluleko. Siba ngcono njengoba ufaka okufakiwe kwangempela.
s4.sample: Lezi yizinombolo eziyisibonelo, hhayi ezakho. Zishintshe ku-Imali, noma uzithathele indawo ngesitatimende noma ngezimpendulo zakho.

legalDoc.draft: Uhlaka locwaningo lokulinga, oluzobuyekezwa ngummeli ngaphambi kokwethulwa. I-Tengo akulona ibhange futhi ayinikezi iseluleko sezezimali. Lesi saziso asisho ukuthi sithobela noma yimuphi umthetho noma isitifiketi.
legalDoc.placeholderWarning: Iqembu elibhekele nesiKhulu Solwazi abakaqanjwa. Kumele bagcwaliswe ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwangempela.

what.title: Lokho i-Tengo ekugcinayo
what.body: Umlando wemali owufakayo (izinsuku, izimali, izincazelo ezimfushane nezigaba), amabhalansi akho, izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile nemali oyikweletayo, ukukhetha kwakho nezilungiselelo, isiteketiso ongasikhetha, kanye nerekhodi lalokho okwenzile ku-app. Uma ugcina i-akhawunti, nekheli lakho le-imeyili. I-Tengo ayiceli futhi ayigcini izinombolo zikamazisi, izinombolo zocingo, ukungena ebhange noma ama-PIN. Izinombolo ezinde ezincazelweni ezingenisiwe ziyafihlwa.

why.title: Kungani
why.body: Kuphela ukubala ukuthi imali yakho ihlala isikhathi esingakanani, imali yakho elandelayo ivame ukungena nini, nezilinganiso ezisesikrinini. Hhayi ngokukhangisa, ukulinganisa isikweletu, izinqumo zokuboleka noma ukuthengisela noma ubani. Ukunikeza imininingwane kungokuzithandela; ngaphandle kwayo asikho isibikezelo.

where.title: Lapho kucutshungulwa khona
where.body:
Njengesivakashi, konke kuhlala kulesi siphequluli kule divayisi futhi isibikezelo sibalwa kudivayisi. Akukho okuthunyelwa ku-Tengo.
Uma ukhetha ukugcina i-akhawunti, imininingwane yakho igcinwa kumhlinzeki wesizindalwazi obalwe ekusetheni (Supabase), esifundeni esikhethwe ngumsebenzisi, futhi ithunyelwa ngokuxhumana okubethelwe. Isibikezelo sisabalwa kudivayisi yakho. Noma yikuphi ukugcina ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika kudinga ukuvikelwa okwanele ngaphansi kwesigaba 72 se-POPIA futhi kuzobalwa lapha ngaphambi kokwethulwa.

who.title: Ubani ongakubona
who.body: Njengesivakashi: noma ubani osebenzisa lesi siphequluli kule divayisi. Sebenzisa ukukhiya nge-PIN efonini eyabiwe. Nge-akhawunti: wena, ngemuva kokungena. Imigqa yomuntu ngamunye ikhiyelwe kuye esizindalwazini. Akukho ukufinyelela kwabasebenzi emigqeni yakho okusethiwe. Uma ukusekela kwake kukudinga, lesi saziso sizoqala sisho ukuthi kukhawulelwa futhi kurekhodwa kanjani.

keep.title: Kugcinwa isikhathi esingakanani
keep.body: Ukuthengiselana okungaphezu kwezinyanga eziyi-12 kuyasuswa kule divayisi lapho i-Tengo ivuleka. Ku-akhawunti, umsebenzi weseva wokukususa ubhaliwe kodwa awukavulwa. Ungasusa konke noma nini; ku-akhawunti, ukususa kususa imigqa yakho nokungena kwakho, futhi uthola irisidi engenayo imininingwane yomuntu siqu. Amakhophi okulondoloza agcinwa ngumhlinzeki wokusingatha asuswa ngokohlelo lwawo, oluzobalwa lapha ngaphambi kokwethulwa.

rights.title: Amalungelo akho
rights.body: Ungabona imininingwane yakho futhi uyikhiphe njenge-JSON noma i-CSV, ulungise noma yikuphi okufakiwe, ucele umuntu ukuthi ahlole umphumela, uhoxise noma yikuphi ukukhetha, futhi ususe konke. Ungakhalaza eqenjini elibhekele elingenhla, nakuMlawuli Wolwazi waseNingizimu Afrika.

not.title: Lokho i-Tengo engekona
not.body: I-Tengo iwucwaningo lokulinga. Akulona ibhange, akuyona inhlangano enikeza izikweletu futhi akuyena umeluleki wezezimali. Izinombolo zayo ziyizilinganiso ezivela emlandweni wakho, futhi ayenzi zinqumo ngawe.

changes.title: Izinguquko
changes.body: Uma lesi saziso sishintsha, inguqulo engenhla iyashintsha futhi i-Tengo ikucela ukuthi usibuke futhi ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke.

use.title: Ukusebenzisa i-Tengo
use.body: I-Tengo imahhala ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi socwaningo lokulinga. Ingeyabantu abadala, abaneminyaka eyi-18 noma ngaphezulu. Yisebenzise kuphela ngemali yakho noma ngezinombolo zokuzenzisa.

estimate.title: Izilinganiso, hhayi izithembiso
estimate.body: Lonke usuku, isabelomali nesiphakamiso kuyisilinganiso esivela emaphethenini adlule. Imali ingangena sekwephuzile noma ingangeni nhlobo, futhi izinkokhelo zingashintsha. Hlola ngaphambi kokwenza isinqumo esibalulekile.

liability.title: Izinqumo zakho
liability.body: I-Tengo ayinikezi iseluleko sezezimali futhi ayinasibopho ngezinqumo ozenza uyisebenzisa. Akukho lapha okukhawulela amalungelo onawo ngaphansi komthetho waseNingizimu Afrika.

accounts.title: Ama-akhawunti
accounts.body: Ama-akhawunti ngawokuzikhethela. Gcina ukufinyelela ekhelini lakho le-imeyili, ngoba ukungena kwenziwa ngekhodi yesikhathi esisodwa. Ungaphuma yonke indawo futhi ususe i-akhawunti yakho noma nini.

ending.title: Ukuphela kocwaningo lokulinga
ending.body: Uma ucwaningo lokulinga luphela, uzotshelwa ku-app futhi unikezwe isikhathi sokukhipha imininingwane yakho ngaphambi kokuthi isuswe.

complaints.title: Izikhalazo
complaints.body: Xhumana neqembu elibhekele elingenhla. Ngezikhalazo zobumfihlo ungaya futhi kuMlawuli Wolwazi waseNingizimu Afrika.

account.title: I-akhawunti
account.unavailable: Ama-akhawunti awasethiwe kule khophi ye-Tengo. Iphrofayela yakho ihlala kule divayisi.
account.lead: Gcina ku-akhawunti ukuze ukugcine kunoma iyiphi idivayisi. Kungokuzikhethela: i-Tengo isebenza ngokugcwele ngaphandle kwayo.
account.leadSaved: Iphrofayela yakho igcinwe ku-akhawunti yakho. Isibikezelo sakho sisabalwa kule divayisi.

facts.passwordless: Alikho igama eliyimfihlo: ungena ngekhodi yesikhathi esisodwa ethunyelwa ku-imeyili yakho.
facts.device: Isibikezelo sakho sisabalwa kudivayisi yakho. I-akhawunti igcina imininingwane yakho kuphela.
facts.where: Kugcinwe kumhlinzeki wesizindalwazi obalwe esazisweni sobumfihlo. Nguwe kuphela ongafunda imigqa yakho.
facts.leave: Phuma yonke indawo, khipha noma ususe konke noma nini.

account.adultHint: I-Tengo ingeyabantu abadala. Ayiceli futhi ayigcini usuku lokuzalwa.
account.codeLead: Sithumele ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa ku-{{email}}. Isebenza kanye futhi iphelelwa yisikhathi maduze.
account.resendIn_one: Thumela ikhodi entsha ngemuva komzuzwana o-{{count}}
account.resendIn_other: Thumela ikhodi entsha ngemuva kwemizuzwana engu-{{count}}
account.uploadLead: I-akhawunti yakho ayinalutho. Gcina iphrofayela yakho kusuka kule divayisi kuyo. Bese isuswa kule divayisi futhi igcinwe ku-akhawunti yakho.
account.emptyLead: I-akhawunti yakho intsha futhi ayinalutho. Faka imali yakho ukuze uthole isibikezelo sakho sokuqala.
account.conflictLead: Le divayisi nayo inephrofayela. Ngokuvamile ugcina imininingwane ye-akhawunti. Ungayithathela indawo ngemininingwane yale divayisi esikhundleni salokho.
account.useLead: Imininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho izosetshenziswa kule divayisi.
account.replaceWarn: Ukuthathela indawo kususa lokho i-akhawunti enakho manje futhi akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
account.savedFacts: Khipha konke iseva ekugcinayo noma nini, njenge-JSON noma i-CSV.
account.deleteBody: Kususa yonke imigqa iseva enayo ngawe nokungena kwakho, futhi ikunike irisidi engenayo imininingwane yomuntu siqu. Amakhophi okulondoloza agcinwa ngumhlinzeki wokusingatha aphelelwa yisikhathi ngokohlelo lwakhe, olubalwe esazisweni sobumfihlo.
account.deleteWarn: Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa. Khipha kuqala uma ufuna ikhophi.

errors.rate_limited: Ikhodi ithunyelwe isikhashana esedlule. Linda umzuzu, bese uzama futhi.
errors.invalid_code: Leyo khodi ayisebenzanga. Yihlole, noma uthumele entsha.
errors.generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama futhi.
